children: Can I collect my order in store?
Yes. Choose free store pickup and a collection slot at checkout. This prototype uses demo slots; a live order needs a confirmed ready-for-collection message.
Where do you deliver, and what does it cost?

Demo only: Central costs R35, North R45, and South R50, with a R100 minimum basket. Estimated delivery is 1–2 hours during opening hours. Actual suburbs, fees and service times need store confirmation.
What if my order arrives damaged?
Contact the shop with your order number and photos. This is a placeholder returns process; the final policy must explain remedies, food-related exclusions and applicable consumer rights.
How do I check ingredients and allergens?
Check the product’s ingredients tab and physical label before eating. All ingredients in this prototype are fictional. Ask the store for verified information, especially if you have an allergy.
Why do imported labels sometimes look different?
Packaging can vary by market. The live shop should provide verified local label information, origin, storage and expiry details for each batch.
